newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were weaker in thin after-hours trade on Wednesday on sporadic selling after posting modest gains during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 0.5 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark March was 0.4 yen lower at 135.5 yen. Volume was thin with only 4,286 lots traded.
During the day, prices edged firmer as the yen's weakness against the dollar stimulated short-covering.
"The market lacked fresh incentives except for the currency market. Direction hinges on how far the dollar will rise against the yen," one trader said.
